hair.color.meaning: Return only persistent hair color and multicolor structure.

hair.length.meaning: Return only one identifiable representative hair-length Danbooru tag.

hair.style.meaning: Return only persistent hairstyles; exclude temporary states caused by wetness, wind, or hand movements.

head.other.meaning: Return only fixed head traits other than hair and eyes. Include horns, animal ears, pointy ears, antennae, and facial markings; exclude hats, glasses, and hair ornaments.

eyes.color.meaning: Return only eye color. Put heterochromia in eyes.structure.

eyes.structure.meaning: Return only persistent iris, pupil, and eye-count traits; exclude expressive eye states.

body.skin.meaning: Return only persistent skin color; exclude lighting, blushing, and stains.

body.build.meaning: Return the corresponding Danbooru tag only when overall body build is clear.

body.proportions.meaning: Return only Danbooru tags for clear, persistent body proportions.

body.breast_size.meaning: Select only one when the breasts are visible and their size can be clearly determined.

marks.distinctive.meaning: Return persistent moles, freckles, scars, tattoos, and birthmarks on body parts other than the head.

nonhuman.features.meaning: Return only persistent nonhuman body structures outside the head, such as wings and tails.

custom.meaning: Return only persistent distinctive humanlike appearance that belongs to no other specific group.
